description: Flags kept by hand for the cross-study consistency queue (soa2usdm.consistency). Each flag names a normalised phrase and the studies it was raised for; the queue page shows every item with that phrase. Adding or removing a flag decides nothing.

flags.note: Panel or named test. The targeted decisions run changed unsure to named test (finding kind pc), routed PC by RT-9. The lab_and_purpose entry also names pirtobrutinib in the same samples; the agent kept named test because the label names only rosuvastatin. A strict reading of the sample-collection rule would give panel.
Other or panel. The footnote lists survival, subsequent therapies and new malignancy.
Grain other. The device is not described in the input (it could be the NRS diary device).
